Guidance & outlook: The initiatives currently underway are expected to deliver working capital improvements of approximately INR250 crores in the current financial year and generate cash flow from operations of more than INR300 crores during the year.
We remain committed to achieving INR1,000 crores of direct -to-consumer revenue by FY29 with an operating margin of at least 15% from this segment.
On FY24, we were 15.5%, then it came down to 14.5% now, 13% in FY26.
Growth & demand: During the quarter, our revenue grew by 30% year-over-year to INR690 crores, while EBITDA increased by 22% to INR50 crores.
Profit after tax grew sharply at 288% year -over- year to INR26 crores.

Overall, Q1 FY27 reflects a healthy start to the year with 30% revenue growth, strong growth in owned brands, and 47% growth in owned brands EBITDA, a sharp increase in PAT and EPS and meaningful reduction in working capital days.
Margins & costs: EBITDA increased by 22% year-on-year to reach INR50 crores, compared with INR41 crores in Q1 FY26.
EBITDA from owned brands grew to 11.5% from 10% in Q1 FY26.
So we've observed that there was a reduction in margins, gross profit margin, EBITDA margin.
Capex & expansion: So for FY26, I think the brand after acquisition grew about 30%.

Nothing to report yet, but we are clearly, since the past 6 or 7 years, we've done 3 acquisitions and all of our 3 major brands that our current focus is on have been added to the company via acquisitions.
So if something attractive comes along, we are open to acquisitions, especially in the current year, given the fact that we expect over INR300 crores of cash flow from operations.
Balance sheet & cash: Sir, the first question is on the initiatives we talked about reducing working capital by INR250 crores.
So as you said that you are expecting INR300 crores of operating cash flow.
So I think that as is spelled out in our presentation, we plan to reduce working capital by about INR250 crores between reduction in inventory and reduction in receivables.

Guidance & outlook: Based on current momentum and market tailwinds, we expect our U.S. direct - to-consumer revenues to organically grow between 35% to 40% this year to INR375 crores by end of FY '27.
We expect strong growth in profitability in the coming year in the range of 20% to 30%, supported by our increasing contribution from our direct-to-consumer segment and improving efficiencies.
D2C EBITDA numbers improved in line with increasing revenues, reaching a very impressive 12.6% for FY26 versus 11.3% for FY25.
Growth & demand: During the year, our revenue grew by 29% year -over-year to INR2,572 crores, while EBITDA increased by 22% to INR204 crores.
For the full year FY26, revenues grew nearly 30% to INR2,572 crores, led by a healthy growth in the U.S.
PBT before exceptional items grew 45% for the full year to reach INR124 crores, while adjusted PAT grew by 36% to reach INR100 crores.
Margins & costs: Through disciplined initiatives across sourcing, manufacturing efficiencies and organizational integration, we achieved approximately INR40 crores in annual cost savings.
During Q4 FY26, our revenue before bullion sales grew by 33% year -on-year to INR686 crores with EBITDA growing by 40% to INR57 crores.
And as I've mentioned that the EBITDA margins on that are 15% to 20%.
Capex & expansion: Our ambition is to build a INR1,000 crores direct-to-consumer brand by FY29, supported by continued expansion of Jean Dousset and growth across our various other brands, enhance digital capabilities and selective acquisitions that align with our long -term vision.
It began really with the acquisition of Jay Gems, which was the Disney licensee, and then with the acquisition of With Clarity in 2022 and Jean Dousset in 20 25.
We've successfully grown each of the 3 acquisitions that we've done between 3x and 5x over the preceding 4 to 5 years after acquiring the brands.
Balance sheet & cash: Profit after tax before exceptional items grew by 36% to INR100 crores, reflecting the resilience of our business model, focused execution and improving operating leverage across the organization.
During Q4 FY '26 alone, we reduced our gross debt by approximately INR123 crores through improved working capital management and prudent capital allocation and strong cash flow generation .
And the other priority is obviously debt repayment, as you saw in the last quarter we've repaid INR120 crores of debt and we would continue to do so.
